description: This file is a React application entry point that sets up the DOM rendering process by importing React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the root element and renders the App component within React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React components into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
